raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Three Miles tests in the MI30X nightly fail on every run that reaches them, because a kernel asks for more LDS per block than gfx942 has (64 KiB). They pass on MI35X.

| Test | Job | Error |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/fast-gpu/kernels/attention/dsa/test_dsa_indexer.py` | 2-GPU | tilelang `indexer_fwd_kernel_kernel`: `Requested dynamic shared memory 98304-102400 exceeds device limit 65536` |
| `tests/fast-gpu/kernels/attention/dsa/test_dsa_sparse_attention.py` | 2-GPU | tilelang `main_kernel`: 81920-157696 bytes requested, same limit |
| `tests/e2e/megatron/model_scripts/test_qwen3_8_next_4layer_ci.py` | 8-GPU | Triton `OutOfResources: out of resource: shared memory, Required: 73728, Hardware limit: 65536` during training |

The two DSA tests first ran on MI30X on 11-02, when the 2-GPU job stopped timing out, and failed then and on [11-03](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41728316389). `test_qwen3_8_next_4layer_ci` hit the Triton error on [11-01](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41355713231) and 11-03; on 11-02 it failed earlier with an unrelated error.

## Modifications

Add them to `skip_tests` in `nightly-test-amd-miles-rocm10-mi30x.yml`, next to `test_glm5_2_744b_a40b_5layer_ci`, which is skipped for the same reason. `test_qwen3_8_next_4layer_ci` goes on both 8-GPU parts: files are removed before `run_suite.py` partitions the suite, so both parts must remove the same files to split the same list.

## Test plan

- [x] All three paths exist in miles `main`; the matrix parses with the new `skip_tests`.
- [ ] Next MI30X Miles nightly: the skip step removes the files and the remaining tests run.

Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #41774254082](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41774254082)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->

files.patch:
@@ -37,11 +37,13 @@ jobs:
             timeout: 180
             # test_qwen38small: single-request decode of Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 runs at ~20 tok/s on
             # MI300X, so long generations outlast the test client's 180 s request timeout.
-            # test_glm5_2_744b_a40b_5layer_ci: its tilelang indexer kernel needs 98 KiB of LDS
-            # per block; gfx942 has 64 KiB.
+            # test_glm5_2_744b_a40b_5layer_ci, test_dsa_indexer, test_dsa_sparse_attention: their
+            # tilelang DSA kernels need 80-154 KiB of LDS per block; gfx942 has 64 KiB.
             skip_tests: >-
               tests/e2e/sglang/test_session_server_multi_role/test_qwen38small.py
               tests/e2e/megatron/model_scripts/test_glm5_2_744b_a40b_5layer_ci.py
+              tests/fast-gpu/kernels/attention/dsa/test_dsa_indexer.py
+              tests/fast-gpu/kernels/attention/dsa/test_dsa_sparse_attention.py
           # The 4- and 8-GPU suites run past 180 min on MI300X; the 4-GPU suite takes ~155 min on MI355X.
           # As one job, the 4-GPU suite loses its runner every night after 13-16 tests; split it in two.
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-4-gpu-mi350
@@ -59,17 +61,19 @@ jobs:
             partition_size: 2
             part: 2/2
           # The 8-GPU suite no longer finishes in 300 min on MI300X; split it in two.
+          # test_qwen3_8_next_4layer_ci: one of its Triton training kernels needs 72 KiB of LDS
+          # per block; gfx942 has 64 KiB. Both parts skip it so they partition the same file list.
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-8-gpu-mi350
             runner: linux-mi300-8gpu-sglang
             timeout: 300
-            skip_tests: ""
+            skip_tests: tests/e2e/megatron/model_scripts/test_qwen3_8_next_4layer_ci.py
             partition_id: 0
             partition_size: 2
             part: 1/2
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-8-gpu-mi350
             runner: linux-mi300-8gpu-sglang
             timeout: 300
-            skip_tests: ""
+            skip_tests: tests/e2e/megatron/model_scripts/test_qwen3_8_next_4layer_ci.py
             partition_id: 1
             partition_size: 2
             part: 2/2
